data.body: Pushed as Gerrit change 3340 (WIP, hashtag rebar-session-a85e3cd3-9e61-4f25-9de4-cd740e853b4d), patch set 1 = b76a747a4f388efc8587694a2a9b7e68850599c5. make verify exited 0 on that SHA (16:31 to 17:07 PST; 20,891 default-tier + 202 integration passed). Second regression found and fixed before push: dropping the 4.x rows from the window ladder made an explicitly pinned Sonnet 4.6 read as the 200K unlocated floor, and this ticket's own plan review went INDETERMINATE because its verify step refused an ~80K-token input plus the 128K output reserve. 4.x windows now live in PRIOR_GENERATION_WINDOWS (pinned by test_an_explicitly_pinned_prior_generation_model_keeps_its_real_window, which fails 2 of 3 on the pre-fix code). Plan re-reviewed: PASS, signed 16:56 PST. Held in WIP for the 0.14.1 release.
